tonight.headline: Gordon is still on the bench on Friday morning — still the only fix
body: Bad news first: at the 13:05Z snapshot DK Metcalf is still in the flex and Ollie Gordon II is still on the bench — 2.2 projected points given up, the third brief running to flag it. Nothing on Thursday's reports changes the call: neither is listed (NFL.com Week 8 report), and Jaylen Wright practised fully, which is already in Gordon's 14.4.

No AVIATO player has played. ESPN projects 128.1 to Guillo-tinas' 88.9, 70%. Jalen Coker, dropped by mistake on Wednesday, scored a touchdown for nobody on Thursday night (9.6) and is on Chem waivers until Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX. Two moves: Gordon for Metcalf before Sunday 12:00, and the Coker claim if it is not already in.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: 0.0 to 0.0; every AVIATO starter plays Sunday. Guillo-tinas project 88.9 with Lamar Jackson questionable on their bench. ESPN gives AVIATO 70%.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Sunday inactive among AVIATO's starters — none is on Thursday's reports — or Gordon left on the bench again, which costs 2.2 projected points in a game ESPN already favours.

case.label: The gap
case.body: lineup_check.py at 13:05Z: as set 128.0, projection lineup 130.2 — one change, Gordon over Metcalf in the RB/WR flex, 2.2 points, labelled PROJECTION (just outside the two-point coin-flip line).

case.label: The news
case.body: None either way. Neither is on the Wednesday or Thursday report (Steelers.com 28 Oct; NFL.com Week 8 report, read 30 Oct). Gordon is Miami's lead back with Achane on IR (Athlon 28 Oct); Pittsburgh's air yards have been under 200 three straight weeks (Yahoo Outlook). No unpriced news — so the projection decides.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claim clears Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX — he misses Week 8 either way
doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Carried. Still on Chem waivers at 13:05Z to Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX. He scored Thursday for nobody. If the claim is already in, leave it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Jalen Coker. Wednesday morning's card said drop Fairbairn — a second kicker, on a Houston bye. AVIATO still carry two kickers, and Coker is on Chem waivers until Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX.

case.label: The player
case.body: Played every down Thursday at Green Bay: 2 catches on 5 targets, 37 yards, a 26-yard fourth-down touchdown and a lost fumble, no injury (Bleacher Report, NBC 29 Oct). 9.6 points (archive, Week 8 live); 13 targets in Week 6, 4 in Week 7.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn cannot start while Bass kicks; Chem starts one kicker and streams it (STRATEGY §5). This is an exception to the churn rule, stated: the rule stops a considered decision being reversed, and nothing in the activity log or Wednesday's brief makes this drop a decision — the plan was the other player.

case.label: The clock
case.body: He misses Week 8 whatever happens — the claim clears after tonight's game. ESPN shows this brief no pending claims, so it cannot tell whether yours is placed. Chem priority resets weekly but AVIATO are 10th: any rival claim beats yours.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive) — then the receiver room did not need him back. If the drop was deliberate and the owner knows something no report says, skip the claim.

doFirst.sources: League file activity 28 Oct 15:13Z · NBC 29 Oct · Bleacher Report 29 Oct · archive

whatWentWrong.title: The defence add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: 28 Oct 15:13Z: Commanders D/ST in, Jalen Coker out. The card said Fairbairn. Coker scored 9.6 on Thursday for nobody.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Second day running a drop processed on the wrong player: on Wednesday morning the Bass claim took the Broncos D/ST instead of Fairbairn; that afternoon the D/ST add took Coker. Fairbairn — on bye, a second kicker — survived both.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Coker claim above. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting; the risk is a rival claiming him first.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Coker drop was deliberate — then skip the claim and say why, so the next run stops recommending it.

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup reset put Metcalf in the flex
whatWentWrong.lead: Still in effect at 13:05Z Friday: Metcalf in the flex, Gordon on the bench — 2.2 projected points given up.

case.label: What happened
case.body: With Coker gone, the flex went to Metcalf rather than Gordon. Gap 2.2 by lineup_check.py.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The swap card above. Metcalf locks first (Sun 12:00), so make it before then.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Gordon in Week 8 (archive).

doNotChase.name: Rico Dowdle
doNotChase.lead: Your own Warren's backup — a handcuff.

case.label: The case for
case.body: Back from injury: 9 carries for 41 yards and a team-high 6 targets in Week 7 (Yahoo Outlook); his role grows only if Warren misses time (Sporting Tribune 27 Oct). Warren is on no injury report this week.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9.4 projected, below all four AVIATO backs; Warren keeps two-thirds of the carries and the third downs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Warren hurt — then Dowdle is a free-agent add.

case.label: What would change it

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage. Every rostered receiver is now inside this week's expert top 24, so none is movable; the RB and TE bars are not cleared. Seven weeks of data. The one receiver move is undoing Wednesday's drop — the Coker claim above.
